hero.title: REFUNDS
hero.subtitle: Orders that failed to process are refunded in full as balance on your account.

lookup.label: Find your refund
lookup.hint: For your security the payout link is sent to the email and WhatsApp number you used at checkout — it is never shown on this page.
lookup.sent: If those details match an order awaiting a refund, we have sent the claim link to the registered email and WhatsApp. Check your spam folder too.

claim.heading: Refund
claim.invalid: This refund link is invalid or has expired.
claim.invalidHelp: Links are valid for 30 days. Request a new one using the form below.

form.heading: Where should we send it?
form.subtitle: Double-check the details. We transfer to this account within 1 business day.

status.WAITING_ACCOUNT: Waiting for you to create an account

submitted.heading: Account details saved
submitted.body: Thank you. We will transfer to the account above within 1 business day, and you will get a confirmation by email and WhatsApp.

done.heading: Your refund has been sent
done.body: We have transferred your refund to the account you gave us. Funds usually arrive within minutes, but can take up to 24 hours depending on the receiving bank.

invoiceNote.balance: {{amount}} has been returned to your account balance and can be spent right away.
invoiceNote.manual: {{amount}} will be refunded to you. Tell us where to send it so we can transfer the money.
invoiceNote.manualDone: {{amount}} has been transferred to the account you gave us.
invoiceNote.claim: {{amount}} will be refunded as balance. Create an account first to receive it.
invoiceNote.claimDone: {{amount}} has been refunded to your account balance.

account.heading: Create an account to receive {{amount}}
account.subtitle: Your refund is paid to your account balance. Create an account, or sign in if you already have one, and our admin will verify it.
account.balanceNotice: The refund is credited as balance on this site and can be spent straight away. Balance cannot be withdrawn to a bank account.
account.mustMatch: Use the same email or WhatsApp number you ordered with: {{contact}}
account.signedInHelp: You are signed in. Claim this refund to the account you are using.
account.signInHelp: Already have an account with the same email or number? Sign in first and you will be brought back here.

errors.name: Name must be at least 3 characters
errors.password: Password must be at least 6 characters

claimed.heading: Account linked
claimed.body: Our admin will verify it and credit your account balance within 2x24 working hours. You can follow it on the Refunds page in your account.

myRefunds.title: Refunds
myRefunds.subtitle: Refunds you have claimed to this account.
myRefunds.empty: You have not claimed any refunds yet.
myRefunds.dueNote: Within 2x24 working hours of your claim.
